title: IT60115: Embedded Low Power Systems
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Prerequisite: NoneIntroduction to Embedded and Low Power VLSI Systems. Embedded
Ubiquitous Control Architecture for Low Power Systems. Power optimization and
synthesis at behavioral and Systems level using formal methods. Multi-objective
synthesis of low power real-time distributed embedded systems. Memory
exploration for low power embedded systems. Dynamic power management. High
level power analysis and optimization. RTL synthesis of low power embedded
systems. Low power embedded systems in ultra deep sub-micron technologies.
